goal: Return structured JSON-RPC error responses instead of empty HTTP 403 replies when -rpcwhitelist rejects calls
Prevent confusing JSON type errors for IPC clients that do not receive HTTP headers
Ensure bitcoin-cli -generate fails visibly on permission denials instead of reporting success with null output
agreement: Verified by testing whitelist handling and confirming DoS response-size fixes on macOS (Zippo76)
Resolved objection: batch denials caused memory amplification and log spam (Zippo76, janb84)
Suggests merging PR #36758 first because this change exposes that bug more widely (pinheadmz)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it brings -rpcwhitelist denials into compliance with the JSON-RPC 2.0 specification
Fixes misleading JSON type errors when refused calls are sent over IPC without HTTP headers
Stops bitcoin-cli -generate from exiting successfully with null output when calls are refused
